text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"—Katsuragi Ace was strong in the Japan 
Cup, but I wonder if a big part of it was 
just how well the race unfolded for her~."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
There's no way she can pull off that 
racing style over 2,500 meters. Today, 
it's gotta come down to either C.B. or 
Rudolf, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
—Ugh! It really ticks me off how people 
are still calling S-cchi's win a fluke! 
Just you watch today's Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
“That's just the natural backlash from 
Ace-chan pulling off something so 
incredible, though. And I'm sure today as 
well...!”

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
She will surely show us. The running of an 
"ace" defying all odds—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Lately, a thought crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Everyone finds courage in the way I run, 
in the way I live my life.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
They call me... the "Ace" who defies all 
odds.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if that's the case... then where 
do I get my courage from?”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Where is my trump card for this 
rebellion? Where is my 'Ace'?" I wondered—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
......Well, the answer came quickly 
enough. It was obvious from the very 
start.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The one who gave me courage... The trump 
card I held was...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: My "Ace" is! You, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a ton!! For making me everyone's 
"Ace"!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Well then, the usual!
(————*BANGGG!*)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: âI'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. Looks like today's going to be a 
fun race too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Let us face this anew as challengers. And 
today, I will surpass you...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"CB! Rudolf! This time, I'll show you at 
Nakayama!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace makes her mark— Witness the 
run of the rebel "Ace"!!
